task: P13 'the team the lobby chose, carried into the match' — the master server's lobby balances teams on every join and then throws the answer away, because the joinTicket's 32 signed bytes were exactly full. The game server re-derived a side from slot parity, so a player's team was an accident of join order. Carry a u8 team in the ticket, claim a body BY TEAM, and refuse a full side with a code distinguishable from a full server.
scoutSummary: P11 HAS shipped — ProtocolConstants.PROTOCOL_VERSION is already 5, the spec header reads 5.0.0, and the changelog carries a 5.0.0 row for P11's S_MATCH_STATE change (commit 91492d7, #241). Contracts section 3.2 requires this check before writing the changelog row: P11 shipped, so P13 is 5 -> 6 on its own, not an amendment. Two scout findings changed the work. FIRST: the phase says OnClientConnected 'already has the verified ticket'. It does not — ConnectionInfo carries only PlayerId and DisplayName, both extracted by the transport at the handshake (ledger X-36's precedent). The team has to ride ConnectionInfo the same way, which means Ironfront.Net.Transport is in scope although section 2 does not list it. SECOND: the failing claim path calls Transport.Disconnect(connectionId, DisconnectReason.ServerFull), not CONNECT_DENIED — the slot claim happens AFTER the handshake, so ConnectDenyReason.TeamFull alone would be a value nothing on the failing path could ever send. Contracts consulted: plans/00-shared/team-multiplayer-contracts.md sections 3-4 — the ticket layout and the team value space; plans/00-shared/protocol-spec.md section 12 (ticket), section 3.2 (deny codes), section 15 (changelog + freeze gate); JoinTicket.Issue / TryReadFields — signature change, 8 call sites across 6 projects; ServerActorRegistry.TryClaimPlayerSlot — signature change, gains the team; ConnectionInfo — new Team field, new widest constructor. Conventions applied: pinned-baseline-test-companion.md — four PROTOCOL_VERSION pins asserted 5; each carries a trailing comment naming every bump and its cause, extended rather than re-pinned; development-principles.md SSOT — JoinTicket.MaxTeam is the single authority on a legal team; Ironfront.Net.Configuration references nothing and does not restate it; check-net-layering.ps1 — Ironfront.Net.Configuration is a leaf with zero project references.
